script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text says Abram went to live in Egypt for a while, but it does not say he planned a short stay rather than a move.
Papa invents a trip he packed for that turned into a years-long stay. That adds a journey to his backstory.
Even as a guess, saying fear was driving Abram adds a reason for his actions that the text does not state.
The text says the officials commended Sarai to Pharaoh, but it does not say they went straight to him.
Saying a warning would have saved everybody trouble asserts an outcome the text does not give.
The text says Pharaoh treated Abram well and Abram acquired the listed animals and servants. It does not say Pharaoh gave each of them to Abram.
The parking-lot joke calls the servants, as well as the animals, 'stuff.' It makes people the subject of a demeaning joke.
The text lists animals and servants but does not say Abram had 'plenty' of both.
